name: Callista Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Callista Industries Ltd is in the business of trading of Textile goods[1]
keyPoints:
Change in Main Objects:[1]
In FY24, the company amended its Memorandum of Association to include packaging materials. It will now manufacture, process, design, buy, sell, export, import, and deal in various packaging products like cardboard, corrugated, pillow, plastic, and polythene packing, along with gunny bags, containers, bottles, and hollow wares made from plastic, fibres, leather, PVC, polypropylene, and other synthetic materials.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
